prompts:
Classify the acoustic instrument bongo in the Hornbostel-Sachs family system.
A: chordophone (string instrument)
B: aerophone (wind instrument, including free reeds)
C: membranophone (tensioned membrane instrument)
D: idiophone (solid body instrument)
Reply with one letter only.

Which Hornbostel-Sachs family contains the traditional acoustic bongo?
A: chordophone (string instrument)
B: aerophone (wind instrument, including free reeds)
C: membranophone (tensioned membrane instrument)
D: idiophone (solid body instrument)
Reply with one letter only.

Which of these four acoustic instrument families contains the traditional bongo?
A: strings vibrating under tension (chordophone)
B: wind instrument, air driven, including free reeds (aerophone)
C: tensioned membrane generating sound (membranophone)
D: solid body generating sound, not strings or a tensioned membrane (idiophone)
Classify by sound generation, not playing action or the resonating body. Air-driven free reeds are aerophones. A membrane used only as soundboard does not imply membranophone.
Answer with one letter only.
